title: New Orleans Jazz Museum

services.name: Admissions
services.desc: Visitors to the New Orleans Jazz Museum have access to a series of rotating exhibitions on themes relating to jazz history and culture. Current exhibitions include: The First Piano Professors and Loss Music of Early New Orleans, Less is More: The Photography of Steve Rapport, he King at 100: Clifton Chenir, Congo Square to the World: Early Jazz in New Orleans,‍ ‍It All Started In Jane Alley: Louis Armstrong in New Orleans, Drumsville: Evolution of the New Orleans Beat, and Face Value: The Illusions of Power and Money. With listening stations, instruments, photographs, artwork, and more, each exhibit is intentionally designed to personally engage each visitor. All exhibitions listed are open
